name: UNSTUCK – Unified Platform Workflow (CV Processing, Scrapers, DB Sync & Analytics)

parameters.responseBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  success: true,
  message: 'Workflow executed successfully. Profile calibrated, jobs matched, and radar dispatched.',
  user: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user || {},
  skills: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user?.skills || [],
  name: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user?.name,
  professional_title: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user?.title,
  experience_level: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user?.experience_level,
  summary: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.user?.summary,
  matches_found: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.highScoreMatches || 0,
  total_scraped_matches: $('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.totalMatches || 0,
  top_jobs: ($('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.jobs || []).slice(0, 5),
  email_notified: ($('9. Prepare Notification & Rank').first()?.json?.highScoreMatches || 0) > 0
}) }}
